people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.
translations.bsb: And seven full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile.
translations.kjv: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.
translations.asv: And seven days were fulfilled, after that Jehovah had smitten the river.
